qualification.reason: The document is an official Request for Proposals (RFP) issued by the Delaware Division of Public Health for health programs and services. It includes a solicitation overview, scope of services, submission deadlines, evaluation criteria, and contract terms, clearly indicating an active procurement opportunity.

quotes.quote:
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES 
Delaware Health Fund – FY 2028 Health Programs and Services 
ISSUED BY 
DIVISION OF PUBLIC HEALTH 
CONTRACT NUMBER HSS 28 001
This request for proposals (“RFP”) is issued pursuant to 29 Del. C. §§ 6981 and 6982.

Deadline for Receipt of Proposals 
Date: September 15, 2026 at 1:00 PM EDT
Eligibility: This RFP is open to private organizations.

Funding priorities: Consistent with the General Assembly’s operating-budget epilogue (FY 2027 Budget Act, Senate Bill 335, § 33), the recommended award list shall prioritize tobacco control, cessation, and cancer prevention and treatment programs, and no less than 45% of funding received from the Master Settlement Agreement each fiscal year shall be recommended for those programs.

Criteria Weight 
Statement of Need (§ II.A of proposal)-Delaware-specific evidence of the health need and the service gap the program fills; for returning organizations, including prior-year results.
